summary: Lemonade, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a New Business Financing Agreement with Hannover Re (Ireland) DAC, providing up to $250 million to fund sales and marketing growth from 2027-2028. The agreement is a financing facility, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. It outlines capital commitments, repayment via a percentage of premiums collected, and a rate of return based on Treasury bills plus 5.8%. No equity or control changes occur. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation event.
